Container.Name: sbrw-rs
Container.Overview: A Need for Speed World server for the SBRW launcher in one container: the game API, XMPP chat, free-roam and the race relay. Set Public IP to the address players reach this server on and forward the four ports on your router. Setup: https://github.com/kylephillipsau/sbrw-rs/blob/main/docs/unraid.md
Container.Requires: Before the first start, create the data folder owned by nobody:users: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/sbrw-rs && chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/sbrw-rs

Config.Name: Public IP
Config.Description: The IP address players connect to: your public IP for friends on other networks. An IP, not a host name.

Config.Name: Game API
Config.Description: TCP: the launcher and game API. Keep the host port the same as the container's.

Config.Name: XMPP
Config.Description: TCP: chat and server pushes. Keep the host port the same as the container's.

Config.Name: Free-roam
Config.Description: UDP: free-roam. Keep the host port the same as the container's.

Config.Name: Race relay
Config.Description: UDP: races. Keep the host port the same as the container's.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, backups, captures and sbrw.toml. Must be owned by 99:100 (nobody:users).

Config.Name: Capture
Config.Description: Record traffic into the data folder's captures/, e.g. http,xmpp,udp-freeroam,udp-race. Captures hold session tokens.
